- Role: Senior GRC Manager (reports to Jonas, SecOps org)
- Location: SF Bay Area (remote-eligible)
- Target start: Sep 15, 2025
- Proposed comp: $170k base + 10% target bonus + 0.10% equity (4-year, 1-year cliff) — still pending comp-band confirmation

Attached: SR-GRC-Job-Brief.pdf (candidate fit notes). Marcus, can you confirm the correct comp band and whether the proposed package requires an exception? Lauren, once comp is confirmed I’ll need HR to generate the draft offer for manager approval. Evelyn, flagging in case you want to review prior to send.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marcus confirms comp band and recommended salary range by EOD.
2) Jonas + Evelyn sign off on role-specific considerations.
3) Lauren prepares offer and DocuSign link for candidate.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks Soojin — great candidate, I was on the final loop and recommend moving forward. A couple of notes from my side:

- The role will own vendor risk and intake automation work; we should make sure the base and level reflect the hands-on engineering/security program experience.
- If Marcus flags the proposed base as high relative to the band, consider moving equity up slightly rather than base to preserve budget predictability.
- Recruiter requested a two-week window for candidate to review the offer — ideally we send by next Wednesday (7/16).

Happy to approve once comp band confirmation is received.

Folks — checked the Q3 bands (attached comp-band-2025-Q3.xlsx). Notes: 

- Senior GRC Manager maps to band 5B (senior IC/Manager mix). Typical base range: $140k–$160k in SF comp table; midpoint $150k.
- Proposed $170k base exceeds the formal band by ~6–21%. Equity guidance: 0.08%–0.15% for band 5B (we can go to 0.12% without special exec approval). Bonus target standard at 10%.
- Given candidate's unique vendor-risk automation background and faster go-to-impact, I recommend the following offer structure that stays within budgeting flex: 
  - Base: $160,000 (top of band)
  - Bonus: 10% target
  - Equity: 0.12% (4-year schedule)

If you strongly prefer to hit the $170k base, we’ll need a compensation exception routed to Evelyn for one-off approval and an explanation for the budget owner.

I’ve attached the comp band spreadsheet. If HR needs a formal exception memo I can draft it — ping me.

-Marcus Lin
